status: Qualified proposed host-guard change; merge state is separate.
scope: Actual L40S public API native live-metadata check vs pristine preceding public Python namespace, sharing unchanged GPU methods/native runner. Original eligibility, precision and fallbacks remain unchanged.

event_scope: The eager CUDA-event interval includes launch gaps; graph replay is a separate device-path control.

fa2.name: fa2
fa2.layout_adapter: BHSD views to BSHD and back

actual_public_gpu.reference_policy: Unchanged FP64/rounded equations, actual rounded O, and acceptance criteria; identical prior CPU/CUDA calibration.

qualification.live_metadata_parity: More than 400 actual comparisons, plus parameters/subclasses/parametrizations, mutable storage offsets/gradient flags, cold/warm, required-loader errors, fallback and compilation checks.
qualification.sanitizers: PR69 all four passing sanitizer runs retained: every selected current CUDA cubin/PTX/SASS pair is byte-identical, GPU-method source/ownership unchanged; no redundant tool rerun.

host_bridge.scope: Actually mapped native C++ bridge in this frozen GPU-validation/timing/code-capture process; mapped inode matches the retained library. GPU cubins are bound separately.

verified_retention.scope: All final actual artifacts, input tensors, native host bridge ELF/build command, loaded CUDA binaries/PTX/SASS and receipts physically verified off-host; raw files outside tracked tree.

limitations: Benefits are case-specific. Short FP16 eager calls show the clearest gains; BF16 short calls include ties and variable paired samples.
Long differences are mixed and include dense D128 regressions below 1%. No uniform long-call or GPU graph speedup is claimed.
Difference of latency medians and median of paired differences need not agree; both and all samples are retained.
The preceding public namespace uses pristine Python policy/API bytes with explicit unchanged native-runner/GPU-module aliases to isolate the guard. It is not a shorter direct-runner proxy.

merged_main_integration.scope: Independent focused current-main integration; the original 96-row evaluation remains primary. Merged A40 D256 and GB10 helpers retained.
